breaking_changes.BC_description: Chalk v2.0.0 requires Node.js 4 or later. Projects running on Node.js versions earlier than 4 will no longer be compatible with this version of Chalk.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade the Node.js runtime to version 4 or higher to use Chalk v2.0.0. If upgrading Node.js is not feasible, continue using Chalk v1.1.3.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.hasColor()` method has been removed. Users must now use the standalone `has-ansi` package for checking ANSI color support in strings.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method:
Replace `chalk.hasColor(str)` with `require('has-ansi')(str)`. Example:
Before: `const hasColor = chalk.hasColor('\u001b[31mred\u001b[0m');`
After: `const hasAnsi = require('has-ansi'); const hasColor = hasAnsi('\u001b[31mred\u001b[0m');`

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.stripColor()` method has been removed. Users must now use the standalone `strip-ansi` package to remove ANSI color codes from strings.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method:
Replace `chalk.stripColor(str)` with `require('strip-ansi')(str)`. Example:
Before: `const clean = chalk.stripColor('\u001b[31mred\u001b[0m');`
After: `const stripAnsi = require('strip-ansi'); const clean = stripAnsi('\u001b[31mred\u001b[0m');`

breaking_changes.BC_description: The `chalk.styles` property has been removed. Users must now use the `ansi-styles` package directly to access ANSI style codes.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method:
Replace access to `chalk.styles` with direct import from `ansi-styles`. Example:
Before: `const bold = chalk.styles.bold;`
After: `const ansiStyles = require('ansi-styles'); const bold = ansiStyles.bold;`
